text:
morgan: Quick flag 11 small but blocking keyboard/a11y issue on the SLO notify preview. When the preview panel opens you can't tab back to the action chips (Assign owner / Pause alerts / Fallback policy). VoiceOver also reads the channel count awkwardly. Can we triage?

sam: Repro steps please so I can add an acceptance test.

morgan: Repro: SLOs > Edit threshold > focus action row > activate preview (Enter). Try Shift+Tab 11 focus stays inside the panel, action chips unreachable until Escape. Mac + VoiceOver.

rachel: I can repro on NVDA too. The preview is focus-trapped but the actions are rendered outside the trap. Short-term fix idea: inject a keyboard-only "Skip to actions" link at the top of the preview that targets #threshold-actions. Makes it tabbable and visible on focus.

aria-bot: Accessibility check: preview needs role=dialog and aria-labelledby on the header. Channel count should be a plain span with aria-live="polite" and read as a sentence (e.g. "Preview 11 3 channels configured"). Toggle must be a proper button with aria-pressed and aria-describedby referencing SR text. Ensure the described element exists before the control for consistent SR pickup.

sam: Good list. For microcopy product suggests swapping compact labels: 'Mute' -> 'Pause alerts', 'Assign' -> 'Assign owner', 'Fallback' -> 'Fallback policy'. Short but clearer for screen readers. We'll keep the visible label concise and use a hidden description for details.

morgan: For the skip link we should use .sr-only but focusable. CSS: .sr-focusable { position: absolute; left: -9999px; } .sr-focusable:focus { left: 16px; top: 12px; } That reveals it on keyboard. Also set target to tabindex=-1 so we can focus it programmatically.

rachel: Tests: add cypress scenario: tab to eye > open preview > Shift+Tab should go to action chips via skip link > activate pause alerts > assert aria-pressed toggles and aria-live announces channel count. I'll add NVDA/VoiceOver smoke steps to the PR checklist.

dev-bot: deploy-preview:staging created for PR #2278 11 https://deploys.redwood/inference/2278 (contains skip-link + aria-labelledby patch).

sam: I'll open the PR with the skip-link + aria-labelledby + toggle aria-pressed + copy swaps. Follow-up: consider reparenting action-row into preview DOM to remove skip link.

morgan: Thanks! Prioritize the small patch to avoid shipping regressions. Ping me if you want to pair on acceptance tests.

rachel: LGTM. I'll run an a11y pass when staging is live.

morgan: Closing when merged. :white_check_mark:
